chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Hasan* (the Good) as Allah’s exclusive attribute, distinguishing it from human perception of good and bad. This highlights the Shia theological principle that all divine decrees, whether perceived as pleasant or difficult by creation, are fundamentally rooted in wisdom and goodness. It serves as a foundation for *al-Hasr* (restriction) of attributes to God, reinforcing the believer's *tawakkul* (trust) in the ultimate benevolence of the Divine Will.
